dataset: YouTube UGC dataset (Google), 20 s audio-removed excerpts, 360p H.264 crf10
licence: CC BY 4.0 per clip (see attribution); dataset attribution file: https://storage.googleapis.com/ugc-dataset/ATTRIBUTION
annotator: single annotator (agent) from 2 fps contact sheets, refined with 10 fps strips around every boundary and every detector disagreement; label resolution 0.1-0.5 s

classes.cuts: hard cut or transition shorter than 0.3 s
classes.partialGraphics: boundaries of animated graphics segments or partial-frame graphic transitions
classes.screenUi: UI state changes inside a screen recording

notes: dev clips were labelled in Phase 5.0 and used to design detectors; heldout clips were labelled before any detector change, but detector thresholds were then revised after inspecting heldout errors, so no untouched test set remains for the revised detector
Sports_360P-11b7 9.6 was found by the gradual detector and confirmed visually (missed in the first labelling pass); 1.4 is a 0.3 s dissolve, counted as a cut
